diagram.manim_description: On a 16:9 canvas with a plain white BG, draw one horizontal row of 6 equal squares, touching side by side and centred on the canvas; the row is about 80 percent of the canvas width. Each square is filled CELL_FILL and has a 3 px INK outline. Under each square, centred, write its position number in GUIDE, left to right: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. Inside every square draw one short thick bar centred in the square, 60 percent of the square's width long and 12 px thick, with rounded ends; horizontal bars lie along the square's horizontal midline and vertical bars along its vertical midline. Square 1: horizontal bar in INK. Square 2: horizontal bar in INK. Square 3: vertical bar in ANSWER. Square 4: horizontal bar in ANSWER. Square 5: vertical bar in INK. Square 6: vertical bar in ANSWER. Around squares 1, 2 and 5 only draw a dashed square outline in FOCUS, 6 px inside the square's own border (the three given cells). Squares 3, 4 and 6 get no dashed outline. The row therefore shows horizontal, horizontal, vertical, horizontal, vertical, vertical. Draw no letters H or V, no words and no legend.
must_not_show: the letters H or V inside the cells
words such as given or found, or a legend
red bars (the colours are INK and ANSWER only)
accuracy_checks: exactly 6 cells in one row
given cells: 1 and 2 horizontal, 5 vertical (INK, dashed FOCUS outline)
found cells: 3 vertical, 4 horizontal, 6 vertical (ANSWER, no dashed outline)
3 horizontal bars and 3 vertical bars in total (the row needs 3 of each symbol)
no three equal bars side by side: the order H H V H V V has at most two equal neighbours (cells 5 and 6 are V V, cells 1 and 2 are H H)
the only other way to fill cells 4 and 6 (V then H) would put three verticals in cells 3, 4 and 5, so the filled row is unique
